title: Warn about variables that are defined only in some execution paths.
summary: If you use --enable-error-code possibly-undefined, mypy generates an error if it cannot verify that a variable will be defined in all execution paths. This includes situations when a variable definition appears in a loop, in a conditional branch, in an except handler, etc. mypy does not enable this error code by default. Use --enable-error-code possibly-undefined to enable it.
